newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Danu denies talk Fin One merger off.
newsitem.headline: Thai Danu denies talk Fin One merger off.

text.p: A merger between Thailand's largest finance firm, Finance One Plc, and medium-sized Thai Danu Bank Plc is on course despite market rumours and local press reports it may have stalled, Thai Danu officials said on Friday.
A request to the stock exchange to extend the period of due diligence for the merger by two weeks had been misinterpreted by local media and market players, the officials told Reuters.

The biggest merger of Thai financial institutions ever was said on May 1 by local newspapers and some market players to be in danger of collapsing because Thai Danu was planning to walk away from the deal due to various problems.

"We are still working out details of the merger deal. The rumours occurred because the period of due diligence which was to have been 30 days has been extended by two weeks," Thai Danu vice-president Satian Tantanasarit told Reuters.
The bank's chief spokeswoman said the valuation and due diligence period would be completed by May 15.
"The process is ongoing. We plan to finish the valuation and due diligence by May 15 after which we will announce the results ...The reports that the merger is having problems are untrue," she added.
